title: The Lion
text:
Lions live in Africa. They live in groups called prides. A lion can sleep for many hours each day.

Lions eat meat. They hunt zebras and deer. Lions are very strong animals.

questions.text: Why does a lion probably need a lot of sleep?
options: Because hunting uses a lot of energy

questions.text: What kind of animal is a lion, based on the passage?

vocabulary.definition: a large continent south of Europe
to rest with your eyes closed and your body still
to chase and catch animals for food
having a lot of power or energy
